data.name: Zuhurat
data.long_meaning: The name Zuhurat is derived from the Arabic word zahara, which means 'to bloom' or 'to blossom'. historical_references.reference: The name Zuhurat al-Qudsi refers to the Prophet Muhammad's Night Journey (Isra and Mi'raj) and his ascension to heaven. This event is believed to have occurred during the 27th night of Ramadan in the year 624 AD.

The name Zuhurat is also associated with a collection of Hadiths (sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad) compiled by Al-Bukhari and Muslim. These Hadiths were collected and authenticated in the late 8th and early 9th centuries AD.
